_experiment.description: Neuron-level OBS pruning on the reference [196,10,10,10] network. Each step removes the hidden neuron (row of W[l] + column of W[l+1] + bias b[l][i]) with the smallest summed OBS saliency (sum of w_q^2/(2*[H^-1]_qq) over the neuron's active, positive-diagonal weights; diagonal group approximation), then adjusts via gradient descent on d_W (not the OBS closed-form group update). Shares neuron_sparsification_log.csv schema with e11 (manifold) / e20 (magnitude) / e21 (obd).
